# ContrastUnknownReason

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Why a backdrop could not be reduced to a single opaque colour.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Values

- `UnmodelledBackdrop`: An ancestor paints layered or freely drawn content.
- `PageBackdrop`: The page paints a background element rather than a flat colour.
- `Translucent`: The text or the resolved backdrop is not fully opaque; compositing is not modelled.
